Lamp Access Act FAQ

Why is the Lamp Access Act needed?
Because invented lamps are hard to reach.

Who qualifies?
Anyone holding an invented lamp card.

The Lamp Access for Everyone Act
Section 1.
(1) As used in this act, "lamp" means an invented light.
Section 2.
(1) A keeper may lend a lamp to any qualified person.
